title: Understanding Displacement
text: Displacement is the change in position of an object. It is a vector quantity, which means it has both magnitude and direction.

title: Initial and Final Positions
text: Identify the initial and final positions of the car. The initial position is $$2.0\, \text{km}$$ west of the traffic light, and the final position is $$5.0\, \text{km}$$ east of the traffic light.

title: Calculating Displacement
text: To find the displacement, subtract the initial position from the final position. Remember to consider the direction (east or west) when calculating.

title: Calculate the Displacement
text: Use the formula: Displacement $$=$$ Final Position - Initial Position. Give the answer as a magnitude in $$\text{km}$$ followed by a direction. Substitute the values: Displacement $$=$$ $$5.0\, \text{km}$$ - $$(\$\$-2.0\, \text{km}\$\$)$$.

title: Direction of Displacement
text: Since the final position is east of the initial position, the displacement is in the eastward direction.
